title: Sign up and be redirected to the dashboard

Fill in the username field with testuser_{{uuid}}
Fill in the email field with testuser_{{uuid}}@appcrons-test.com

Wait for the signup flow to complete

Verify the dashboard shows an authenticated user experience

title: Create an application via the 3-step modal and land on the app details page
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can create an application, enable it in the modal flow, and arrive on the application details page.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signup
Fill in the username field with testuser_{{uuid}}
Fill in the email field with testuser_{{uuid}}@appcrons-test.com
Fill in the password field with Test@1234
Submit the signup form
Wait for the user to land on the dashboard
Click the create-new-application action to open the modal
Fill in the application name field with TestApp_{{uuid}}
Fill in the URL endpoint field with https://testapp-{{uuid}}.onrender.com/active
Select a valid request interval option
Submit the create application step
Wait for the modal to advance to the enable step
Toggle the application enabled switch on
Wait for the modal to advance to the finish step
Click the navigate-to-application action
Verify the application details page is displayed for the newly created application
Verify the application appears as enabled on the details page

title: Disable an enabled application from its details page
description: A newly signed-up user can create an enabled application and then disable it from the application details page, with the toggle updating to the disabled state after processing completes.
category: Disable Application from App Details Page (TC-07)

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signup
Fill a new UUID-based email into the email field (testuser_{uuid}@appcrons-test.com)
Fill a new UUID-based username into the username field (testuser_{uuid})
Fill a valid password into the password field
Submit the signup form
Create a new application from the dashboard using the 3-step create-application modal and keep it enabled through the enable step
Wait for the flow to land on the new application details page
Click the enable/disable toggle to disable the application
Verify the application toggle reflects a disabled/off state after processing completes
Verify a success notification is visible for the disable action

title: Update an application's name, URL, and interval from app details
description: An authenticated user can update application information with a brand-new unique URL and see the updated values reflected after saving.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signup
Fill a unique username into the username field (e.g., testuser_{{uuid}})
Fill a unique email into the email field (e.g., testuser_{{uuid}}@appcrons-test.com)
Fill a valid password into the password field
Submit the signup form
Open the create application flow from the dashboard
Fill a unique application name into the application name field (e.g., MyApp_{{uuid}})
Fill a unique URL endpoint into the URL endpoint field (e.g., https://myapp-{{uuid}}.onrender.com/active)
Proceed to the next step of the modal
Select a valid request interval
Proceed to the next step of the modal
Enable the application in the enable step
Finish the create application flow
Locate the update application information section on the app details page
Clear and fill a new unique application name into the application name field (e.g., UpdatedApp_{{uuid}})
Clear and fill a brand-new unique URL into the URL endpoint field (e.g., https://updatedapp-{{uuid}}.onrender.com/active)
Select a different request interval than the current value
Submit the update application information form
Verify a success notification is visible
Verify the update form shows the newly saved name, URL, and interval values
